facts.text: Her limestone piece Tidewrack Cairn, funded by the Saltmarsh Bursary, was commissioned and admiringly shown by Clonbara Arts Trust.
She teaches Stone and Salt, a praised carving masterclass hosted by Baunmore Stoneyard and funded by Lackaroe Crafts League.
She sits on the Corrib Carving Panel, a public-art jury convened by Clonbara Arts Trust with Inverbeg Studios.
Nine Ropes for Cloonrue, her acclaimed Gaeltacht collaboration, is run with Teach Bánóg Workshop and Mweelrea Harbour Collective.
She returns annually to Quarry Talks, a limestone lecture series programmed by Derrybawn Lime Barn with Ardnaglass Cultural Office.
